policy: A theorem has explicit hypotheses and a proof. Formal verification and originality are separate statuses. No theorem here is advertised as new to the literature.

entries.statement: The 7, Sym2(7), adjoint and Sym3(7) characters imply the eight implemented fermionic coefficient tables.
entries.proof: Lean exact weights plus independent matrix diagonalization and Newton identities.

entries.statement: Changing periodic gauge weight 4 to 3 with the odd-sector weight fixed at 1 changes 8D by 9 and A4 by 9/2, preserving W and 8D-2A4, for every fixed matter content.
entries.proof: Lean, including universal integer matter shifts.
entries.novelty: formalization of the pre-existing Part VII seed relation

entries.statement: Each of the five Table 1 rounding boxes contains no stationary point for the explicitly transcribed infinite potential.
entries.proof: Integer interval arithmetic, analytic Fourier remainder and independent Arb replay.
entries.novelty: specific reproducibility result; priority not established

entries.statement: No common positive integer winding cutoff or common multiplicative fermionic normalization restores stationarity in all five rounding boxes.
entries.proof: Finite exact interval exclusions, uniform infinite-tail bound and disjoint normalization intervals.
entries.novelty: candidate methodological result; literature review incomplete

entries.statement: For each of five listed matter contents and each of two fixed gauge seeds, the enclosed positive small-phase root is the unique global minimum on [0,1].
entries.proof: Exhaustive continuum cover, strict convexity at the root, positive exterior energy gaps; independently checked with Arb.
entries.novelty: specific certified benchmarks; no priority claim

entries.statement: Within the printed massless determinant, restoring the sixth-direction terms at k=R5/R6>=10 cannot reconcile the printed phases.
entries.proof: Exact exponential bound and a uniform derivative-error enclosure.
entries.novelty: bounded alternative explanation; no priority claim

entries.statement: The printed KLY harmonic differentiates to curvature coefficient 18-4Nf.
entries.novelty: consistency check on an existing formula

entries.statement: At a stationary point of the stated small-angle expansion, f_xx=2*zeta(3)*D-A4*x^2/6.
For every nonnegative integer combination of the eight matter generators, 8D-2A4 is congruent to 3 modulo 6 for either gauge seed; 8D is odd for the printed seed and even for the 3+1 seed.
entries.proof: Lean: exact generator moments followed by universal integer congruence proofs.
entries.novelty: formalization of the existing Part VII lattice laws

entries.statement: The ten certified roots give enclosed Higgs masses and compactification scales at fixed mW=80.4 GeV and g4=0.63.
entries.proof: Arb propagation of root and curvature intervals through the stated positive mass formulas.
entries.novelty: certified evaluation of known mass formulas

open.required: Complete written gauge-fixed boundary problem and literature/author comparison; algebraic 3+1 counting alone does not settle every physical assumption.

open.area: Other model contents and multiple Wilson phases
open.required: An individual continuum certificate; ten benchmarks do not certify arbitrary scans.
Keep small-angle hypotheses. A certified full-Fourier benchmark does not promote the moment ceiling into a full-potential theorem.
Algebraic identities may be formalized; numerical diagonalization, experimental inputs and phenomenological viability require their own checks.
Validated differential-equation solutions and full error propagation before claiming interval-certified transition predictions.
Targeted primary-source review followed by expert scrutiny; lack of a search result is not evidence of nonexistence.
Formalize convergence, derivative interchange, tail estimates, convexity and the certificate checker. Present analytic proofs are computer-assisted, not Lean-certified.
